title: INT8 weight-only calibration shadow simulator + SLA guard
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a deterministic shadow-simulator harness that can replay production inference traces with hybrid quantization configurations (FP8 fallback, INT8 weight-only GPTQ/AWQ variants) to validate calibration snapshots, measure answer drift, and exercise rollback/rollback-delay SLAs. The simulator will live in CI and provide: 1) per-model golden-answer delta reports, 2) token-level latency/cost delta estimates, 3) automatic tagging of calibration snapshots that cause regression beyond thresholds. This ticket covers integration with our CI pipeline, telemetry sinks, and an SLA guard that blocks merges or triggers canary rollbacks when regressions exceed agreed limits.
acceptance_criteria: CI job 'quant-shadow-sim' runs end-to-end on each model-bundle change and surface pass/fail status in the PR
Golden-answer delta < 0.6% token-level divergence for base Llama-derivative models; configurable per-model thresholds
Calibration snapshot replay runtime <= 1.5x observed production p95 for the same trace length (measured in simulator mode)
Telemetry emitted to /dashboards/quant-shadow with model, profile, snapshot_id, delta_metrics, and trace_id for every run
When regression threshold is exceeded the merge is blocked and a rollback task (automated or annotated) is created with remediation steps
tasks: Design simulator replay format and protobuf schema for trace+kv state
Implement trace ingestion and deterministic replayer (Python harness) with option to swap model variants at token boundaries
Integrate calibration snapshot loader and consistent seeding for GPTQ/AWQ quant artifacts
Wire telemetry: metrics, histograms, golden-answer diffs, and CI pass/fail status
Add PR status check and merge-block rule tied to quant-shadow-sim result
Create runbook for interpreting diff outputs and rolling back a broken calibration snapshot
notes: We intentionally keep replay determinism strict: same tokenization, same prompts order, same seed for sampling to isolate quantization-induced deltas.
Simulator will support three execution modes: dry-run (quick checksum), smoke (subset of traces), and full-replay (complete trace set).
To contain cost, full-replay only runs nightly; PRs run smoke by default with option to request full run.
We must validate AWQ and GPTQ loader compatibility: some AWQ artifacts require kernel-path changes—add compatibility shim if necessary.
Decision: start with Llama- and Mistral-based bundles; extend to OPT/T5 families in follow-ups.
implementation_plan: Week 1: Data contract (trace schema), prototype deterministic replayer, and simple golden-diff metric
Week 2: Integrate calibration snapshot loader, add AWQ/GPTQ toggle, and runbuilder for CI invocation
Week 3: Metrics plumbing to telemetry and dashboard, thresholding logic, PR status integration
Week 4: Runbook, docs, and onboarding with model oncall and SRE for SLA guard testing
risk_considerations: False positives: small stochastic differences can look like regressions—we mitigate by strict seeding and a multi-metric approach (exact-token-diff + semantic-similarity scores).
Compute cost: replaying full traces at scale is expensive; we use sampled smoke traces for PR gating and nightly full-run with retention window.
Compatibility: older GPTQ artifacts might not be loadable without new kernels—we'll add graceful skipping and a compatibility report per run.
